name: Update Multiple Rows
description: Update multiple rows in a spreadsheet defined by a range. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values/update)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: The drive containing the worksheet to update. If you are connected with any [Google Shared Drives](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351), you can select it here.

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Spreadsheet ID
configurable_props.description: The spreadsheet containing the worksheet to update

configurable_props.name: worksheetId
configurable_props.label: Worksheet ID
configurable_props.description: Select a worksheet or provide a worksheet ID

configurable_props.name: range
configurable_props.label: Range
configurable_props.description: The A1 notation of the values to retrieve. E.g., `A1:E5`

configurable_props.name: rowsDescription
configurable_props.content: Each nested array should represent a row, with each element of the nested array representing a cell/column value (e.g., passing `[["Foo",1,2],["Bar",3,4]]` will insert two rows of data with three columns each). The most common pattern is to reference an array of arrays exported by a previous step (e.g., `{{steps.foo.$return_value}}`). You may also enter or construct a string that will `JSON.parse()` to an array of arrays.
